passive.name: Voracity
passive.description: Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced. If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.

spells.name: Bouncing Blade
spells.description: Katarina throws a Dagger, dealing magic damage to the target and nearby enemies. The Dagger then ricochets onto the ground behind the primary target.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Preparation
spells.description: Katarina tosses a Dagger into the air and gains % Move Speed decaying over seconds.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Shunpo
spells.description: Katarina blinks in the wink of an eye to the target ally, enemy, or Dagger. If it is an enemy, Katarina strikes for magic damage - otherwise she strikes the nearest enemy in range. Picking up a Dagger will reduce this Ability's Cooldown by seconds (). Katarina can blink to any location near the target.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Death Lotus
spells.description: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, rapidly attacking the three nearest enemy champions with a flurry of knives. Each knife deals magic damage and physical damage, and applies % Grievous Wounds for seconds. Total over seconds to each enemy: magic damage and physical damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation DamageCalc was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
